_about: Builds that get a light APP COPY in the v2 tiles, made from the detailed export by scripts/v2/app_copy.mjs (owner rule, CLAUDE.md 2026-10-17: no triangle limit on a build; reduce afterwards). triangles = the target for the copy; crease_deg = edges sharper than this stay hard when the copy is shaded again; site = how the builder's own ground is cut down to the app's flat ground (metres): kept within skirt_m of the building, its height fades to 0 between flat_m and skirt_m, triangles lower than min_m dropped; lift = a material (regex) that lies in the app's ground plane is raised to this height; far_keep = surfaces (material regex) the far file carries besides the mass; lod0_drop = surfaces that are for the far file only; lod1_m = the distance the far file takes over at, for a build with a fine repeat (default 700).
